beats.say: Every circuit you have ever used depends on this one simple part.
A wire is a path for electric current. Usually copper inside, with plastic insulation outside.
In a circuit diagram, a wire is just a straight line. Close the loop, and current flows.
Where wires connect, we draw a dot. Lines that cross with no dot are not connected.
Thicker wire has less resistance, so it carries more current without getting hot.
